keywords_upright: Clareza mental, triunfo da verdade, nova ideia, vitória
keywords_reversed: Confusão mental, tirania, destruição, hostilidade
div_mean_en: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.
div_mean_rev_en: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says – conception, childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.
add_mean_en: Great prosperity or great misery.
add_mean_rev_en: Marriage broken off, for a woman, through her own imprudence.

keywords_upright: Trégua, equilíbrio difícil, indecisão, ponderação
keywords_reversed: Falsidade, duplicidade, deslealdade, impasse rompido
div_mean_en: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other favourable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.
div_mean_rev_en: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.
add_mean_en: Gifts for a lady, influential protection for a man in search of help.

keywords_upright: Coração partido, dor, afastamento, desilusão, corte
keywords_reversed: Cura da dor, perdão, confusão mental superada
div_mean_en: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration.
div_mean_rev_en: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.
add_mean_en: For a woman, the flight of her lover.
add_mean_rev_en: A meeting with one whom the Querent has compromised; also a nun.

keywords_upright: Repouso, recuperação, contemplação, recolhimento
keywords_reversed: Esgotamento, retorno cauteloso, despertar da estagnação
div_mean_en: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design.
div_mean_rev_en: Wise administration, circumspection, economy, avarice, precaution, testament.
add_mean_en: A bad card.
add_mean_rev_en: A certain success following wise administration.

keywords_upright: Conflito vazio, vitória amarga, perda, hostilidade
keywords_reversed: Rancor persistente, luto, arrependimento, reconciliação difícil
div_mean_en: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss, with the variants and analogues of these.
div_mean_rev_en: The same; burial and obsequies.
add_mean_en: An attack on the fortune of the Querent.
add_mean_rev_en: A sign of sorrow and mourning.

keywords_upright: Transição, viagem para águas calmas, superação
keywords_reversed: Dificuldade em seguir em frente, bagagem emocional
div_mean_en: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.
div_mean_rev_en: Declaration, confession, publicity; one account says that it is a proposal of love.
add_mean_en: The voyage will be pleasant.

keywords_upright: Estratégia, cautela, discrição, astúcia, tentativa
keywords_reversed: Conselhos valiosos, plano revelado, honestidade forçada
div_mean_en: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each other.
div_mean_rev_en: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander, babbling.
add_mean_en: Dark girl; a good card; it promises a country life after a competence has been secured.

keywords_upright: Prisão mental, sensação de impotência, restrição
keywords_reversed: Libertação, abertura para saídas, superação de limites
div_mean_en: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.
div_mean_rev_en: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what is unforeseen; fatality.
add_mean_en: For a woman, scandal spread in her respect.

keywords_upright: Ansiedade, noites sem sono, preocupação, pesadelo
keywords_reversed: Esperança renascendo, alívio do desespero, clareza
div_mean_en: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.
div_mean_rev_en: Imprisonment, suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.
add_mean_en: An ecclesiastic, a priest; generally, a card of bad omen.
add_mean_rev_en: Good ground for suspicion against a doubtful person.

keywords_upright: Fim doloroso, fundo do poço, aceitação, novo amanhecer
keywords_reversed: Recuperação, fim do pior, renascimento após a tempestade
div_mean_en: Whatsoever is intimated by the design; also pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation. It is not especially a card of violent death.
div_mean_rev_en: Advantage, profit, success, favour, but none of these are permanent; also power and authority.
add_mean_en: Followed by Ace and King, imprisonment; for girl or wife, treason on the part of friends.
add_mean_rev_en: Victory and consequent fortune for a soldier in war.

keywords_upright: Curiosidade, vigilância, vigilante perspicaz, novidade
keywords_reversed: Fofoca, espionagem, impulsividade, leviandade
div_mean_en: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging.
div_mean_rev_en: More evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state; sickness is also intimated.
add_mean_en: An indiscreet person will pry into the Querent's secrets.

keywords_upright: Ação rápida, ímpeto, determinação intelectual, coragem
keywords_reversed: Agressividade, precipitação, fúria cega, descuido
div_mean_en: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality.
div_mean_rev_en: Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.
add_mean_en: A soldier, man of arms, satellite, stipendiary; heroic action predicted for soldier.
add_mean_rev_en: Dispute with an imbecile person; for a woman, struggle with a rival, who will be conquered.

keywords_upright: Perspicácia, independência, clareza cirúrgica, franqueza
keywords_reversed: Frieza, rancor, críticas destrutivas, isolamento
div_mean_en: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation.
div_mean_rev_en: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale, deceit.
add_mean_en: A widow.
add_mean_rev_en: A bad woman, with ill-will towards the Querent.

keywords_upright: Autoridade mental, discernimento justo, comando lógico
keywords_reversed: Crueldade, autoritarismo, manipulação implacável
div_mean_en: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions – power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth.
div_mean_rev_en: Cruelty, perversity, barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.
add_mean_en: A lawyer, senator, doctor.
add_mean_rev_en: A bad man; also a caution to put an end to a ruinous lawsuit.

keywords_upright: Centelha de criação, nova oportunidade, entusiasmo vigoroso
keywords_reversed: Falta de iniciativa, atrasos, energia bloqueada
div_mean_en: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin, and in a sense the virility which is behind them; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
div_mean_rev_en: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish; also a certain clouded joy.
add_mean_en: Calamities of all kinds.

keywords_upright: Planejamento de longo prazo, visão de futuro, poder de decisão
keywords_reversed: Medo do desconhecido, hesitação, planejamento falho
div_mean_en: Between the alternative readings there is no marriage possible; on the one hand, riches, fortune, magnificence; on the other, physical suffering, disease, chagrin, sadness, mortification. The design gives one suggestion; here is a lord overlooking his dominion and alternately contemplating a globe; it looks like the malady, the mortification, the sadness of Alexander amidst the grandeur of this world's wealth.
div_mean_rev_en: Surprise, wonder, enchantment, emotion, trouble, fear.
add_mean_en: A young lady may expect trivial disappointments.

keywords_upright: Expansão, primeiros frutos do esforço, visão ampla
keywords_reversed: Obstáculos inesperados, atrasos na jornada, desânimo
div_mean_en: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.
div_mean_rev_en: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.
add_mean_en: A very good card; collaboration will favour enterprise.

keywords_upright: Celebração, conquista comunitária, estabilidade, lar
keywords_reversed: Paz passageira, pequenos atritos, celebração incompleta
div_mean_en: They are for once almost on the surface – country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these.
div_mean_rev_en: The meaning remains unaltered; it is prosperity, increase, felicity, beauty, embellishment.
add_mean_en: Unexpected good fortune.
add_mean_rev_en: A married woman will have beautiful children.

keywords_upright: Competição, rivalidade, confronto construtivo, desafios
keywords_reversed: Conflitos desgastantes, discórdia superada, litígio
div_mean_en: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence.
div_mean_rev_en: Litigation, disputes, trickery, contradiction.
add_mean_en: Success in financial speculation.
add_mean_rev_en: Quarrels may be turned to advantage.

keywords_upright: Vitória merecida, reconhecimento público, orgulho
keywords_reversed: Orgulho excessivo, atraso no reconhecimento, queda
div_mean_en: The card has been so designed that it can cover several significations; on the surface, it is a victor triumphing, but it is also great news, such as might be carried in state by the King's courier; it is expectation crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope, and so forth.
div_mean_rev_en: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate; treachery, disloyalty, as of gates being opened to the enemy; also indefinite delay.
add_mean_en: Servants may lose the confidence of their masters; a young lady may be betrayed by a friend.

keywords_upright: Defesa de convicções, coragem sob pressão, resistência
keywords_reversed: Sobrecarga, sensação de desistência, derrota iminente
div_mean_en: It is a card of valour, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife; in business – negotiations, war of trade, barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him.
div_mean_rev_en: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against indecision.
add_mean_en: A dark child.

keywords_upright: Rapidez, notícias velozes, movimento acelerado, fluidez
keywords_reversed: Atrasos frustrantes, pressa precipitada, pânico
div_mean_en: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally, that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.
div_mean_rev_en: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and domestic disputes for persons who are married.
add_mean_en: Domestic disputes for a married person.

keywords_upright: Resiliência, perseverança na última etapa, cautela
keywords_reversed: Cansaço extremo, teimosia defensiva, esgotamento
div_mean_en: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shews that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts – delay, suspension, adjournment.
div_mean_rev_en: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.
add_mean_en: Generally speaking, a bad card.

keywords_upright: Sobrecarga, peso da responsabilidade, esforço hercúleo
keywords_reversed: Colapso pelo excesso, alívio de fardos, delegação
div_mean_en: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honour and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.
div_mean_rev_en: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.
add_mean_en: Difficulties and contradictions, if near a good card.

keywords_upright: Espírito explorador, notícia empolgante, criatividade
keywords_reversed: Impaciência, indecisão, notícias atrasadas ou confusas
div_mean_en: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.
div_mean_rev_en: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.
add_mean_en: Young man of family in search of young lady.

keywords_upright: Ação audaciosa, ímpeto de conquista, paixão ardente
keywords_reversed: Precipitação, rompimentos impulsivos, estresse
div_mean_en: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence.
div_mean_rev_en: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.
add_mean_en: A bad card; according to some readings, alienation.
add_mean_rev_en: For a woman, marriage, but probably frustrated.

keywords_upright: Confiança magnética, calor humano, determinação solar
keywords_reversed: Ciúme, autoritarismo, arrogância, temperamento explosivo
div_mean_en: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of money, or a certain success in business.
div_mean_rev_en: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable. Signifies also – but in certain positions and in the neighbourhood of other cards tending in such directions – opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.
add_mean_en: A good harvest, which may be taken in several senses.
add_mean_rev_en: Goodwill towards the Querent, but without the opportunity to exercise it.

keywords_upright: Liderança visionária, inspiração transformadora, carisma
keywords_reversed: Intolerância, imposição autoritária, expectativas irreais
div_mean_en: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long.
div_mean_rev_en: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.
add_mean_en: Generally favourable; may signify a good marriage.

keywords_upright: Semente de prosperidade, oportunidade financeira, estabilidade
keywords_reversed: Oportunidade perdida, ganância, insegurança material
div_mean_en: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also speedy intelligence; gold. It shews prosperity, comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not.
div_mean_rev_en: The evil side of wealth, bad intelligence; also great riches. In any case it shews prosperity, comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not.
add_mean_en: The most favourable of all cards.
add_mean_rev_en: A share in the finding of treasure.

keywords_upright: Equilíbrio de prioridades, adaptabilidade, malabarismo financeiro
keywords_reversed: Desorganização, sobrecarga financeira, desequilíbrio
div_mean_en: On the one hand it is represented as a card of gaiety, recreation and its connexions, which is the subject of the design; but it is read also as news and messages in writing, as obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment.
div_mean_rev_en: Enforced gaiety, simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of exchange.
add_mean_en: Troubles are more imaginary than real.

keywords_upright: Trabalho em equipe, maestria, reconhecimento de talentos
keywords_reversed: Falta de cooperação, trabalho medíocre, desmotivação
div_mean_en: Métier, trade, skilled labour; usually, however, regarded as a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory.
div_mean_rev_en: Mediocrity, in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.
add_mean_en: If for a man, celebrity for his eldest son.

keywords_upright: Segurança material, economia prudente, conservadorismo
keywords_reversed: Avareza, medo de escassez, apego possessivo
div_mean_en: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance.
div_mean_rev_en: Suspense, delay, opposition.
add_mean_en: For a bachelor, pleasant news from a lady.

keywords_upright: Dificuldade material transitória, sensação de exclusão
keywords_reversed: Recuperação financeira, luz no fim do túnel, ajuda encontrada
div_mean_en: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the form illustrated – that is, destitution – or otherwise. For some cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers – wife, husband, friend, mistress; also concordance, affinities. These alternatives cannot be harmonized.
div_mean_rev_en: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.
add_mean_en: Conquest of fortune by reason.

keywords_upright: Generosidade, partilha de recursos, equilíbrio no dar e receber
keywords_reversed: Desigualdade, dívidas, generosidade com segundas intenções
div_mean_en: Presents, gifts [both of foregoing stem from a mis-translation of the French le présent ("the present", i.e. now)], gratification; another account says attention, vigilance; now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc.
div_mean_rev_en: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.
add_mean_en: The present must not be relied on.
add_mean_rev_en: A check on the Querent's ambition.

keywords_upright: Paciência na colheita, investimento a longo prazo, maturação
keywords_reversed: Impaciência, esforço não recompensado, reavaliação
div_mean_en: These are exceedingly contradictory; in the main, it is a card of money, business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrel – and another innocence, ingenuity [stems from a mis-translation of the French ingénuité ("ingenuousness")], purgation.
div_mean_rev_en: Cause for anxiety regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.
add_mean_en: Improved position for a lady's future husband.

keywords_upright: Dedicação ao ofício, aprimoramento de habilidades, consistência
keywords_reversed: Perfeccionismo paralisante, trabalho repetitivo sem alma
div_mean_en: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage.
div_mean_rev_en: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury. It may also signify the possession of skill, in the sense of the ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.
add_mean_en: A young man in business who has relations with the Querent; a dark girl.
add_mean_rev_en: The Querent will be compromised in a matter of money-lending.

keywords_upright: Autossuficiência, conforto material, independência e elegância
keywords_reversed: Preocupações financeiras ocultas, superficialidade, perdas
div_mean_en: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment.
div_mean_rev_en: Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.
add_mean_en: Prompt fulfilment of what is presaged by neighbouring cards.

keywords_upright: Riqueza consolidada, legado familiar, estabilidade duradoura
keywords_reversed: Disputas de herança, perdas financeiras na família, riscos
div_mean_en: Gain, riches; family matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family.
div_mean_rev_en: Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry, pension.
add_mean_en: Represents house or dwelling, and derives its value from other cards.
add_mean_rev_en: An occasion which may be fortunate or otherwise.

keywords_upright: Desejo de aprender, jovem disciplinado, boas notícias financeiras
keywords_reversed: Falta de foco, procrastinação, desperdício de talentos
div_mean_en: Application, study, scholarship, reflection; another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof; also rule, management.
div_mean_rev_en: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality, luxury; unfavourable news.
add_mean_en: A dark youth; a young officer or soldier; a child.

keywords_upright: Trabalho árduo, lealdade inabalável, rotina produtiva
keywords_reversed: Teimosia cega, estagnação na rotina, lentidão excessiva
div_mean_en: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude – all on the normal and external plane.
div_mean_rev_en: inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.
add_mean_en: An useful man; useful discoveries.
add_mean_rev_en: A brave man out of employment.

keywords_upright: Praticidade generosa, acolhimento próspero, carinho e cuidado
keywords_reversed: Dependência material, negligência do lar, estresse prático
div_mean_en: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.
div_mean_rev_en: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.
add_mean_en: Dark woman; presents from a rich relative; rich and happy marriage for a young man.

keywords_upright: Sucesso nos negócios, maestria financeira, solidez e proteção
keywords_reversed: Ganância desenfreada, tirania materialista, perdas de investimento
div_mean_en: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts and attainments of this kind; success in these paths.
div_mean_rev_en: Vice, weakness, ugliness, perversity, corruption, peril.
add_mean_en: A rather dark man, a merchant, master, professor.

keywords_upright: Amor transbordante, novos sentimentos, intuição pura
keywords_reversed: Bloqueio emocional, carência, desilusão amorosa
div_mean_en: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
div_mean_rev_en: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.
add_mean_en: Inflexible will, unalterable law.

keywords_upright: Parceria verdadeira, atração mútua, harmonia, união
keywords_reversed: Desentendimento, desencontro afetivo, desconfiança
div_mean_en: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes, and – as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination – that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.
div_mean_rev_en: [Many/most/all copies of Waite's The Pictorial Key to the Tarot and The Key to the Tarot are missing a reversed divinatory meaning for this card. However, at least one source (Huson) gives "passion".]
add_mean_en: Favourable in things of pleasure and business, as well as love; also wealth and honour.

keywords_upright: Celebração, amizade, união, alegria compartilhada
keywords_reversed: Excesso, intrigas em grupo, comemoração vazia
div_mean_en: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.
div_mean_rev_en: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.
add_mean_en: Unexpected advancement for a military man.
add_mean_rev_en: Consolation, cure, end of the business.

keywords_upright: Apatia, descontentamento, oportunidades ignoradas
keywords_reversed: Novo entusiasmo, despertar para o que está ao redor
div_mean_en: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
div_mean_rev_en: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.
add_mean_en: Contrarieties.

keywords_upright: Lamentação pelas perdas, tristeza, foco no que se foi
keywords_reversed: Esperança no que resta, superação do luto, reconciliação
div_mean_en: It is a card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not without bitterness or frustration.
div_mean_rev_en: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.
add_mean_en: Generally favourable; a happy marriage; also patrimony, legacies, gifts, success in enterprise.
add_mean_rev_en: Return of some relative who has not been seen for long.

keywords_upright: Nostalgia afetuosa, memórias doces, reencontro, pureza
keywords_reversed: Preso ao passado, imaturidade, superação da infância
div_mean_en: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as – for example – on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are disporting in an unfamiliar precinct.
div_mean_rev_en: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.
add_mean_en: Pleasant memories.

keywords_upright: Ilusões, múltiplos desejos, castelos no ar, escolhas
keywords_reversed: Clareza de objetivos, pés no chão, foco na realidade
div_mean_en: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent or substantial is suggested.
div_mean_rev_en: Desire, will, determination, project.
add_mean_en: Fair child; idea, design, resolve, movement.
add_mean_rev_en: Success, if accompanied by the Three of Cups.

keywords_upright: Abandono voluntário, busca de propósito, desapego
keywords_reversed: Medo de partir, apego ao que não faz bem, hesitação
div_mean_en: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical – giving joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shews the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence – either for good or evil.
div_mean_rev_en: Great joy, happiness, feasting.
add_mean_en: Marriage with a fair woman.

keywords_upright: Desejo realizado, satisfação, contentamento, plenitude
keywords_reversed: Insatisfação material, egoísmo, felicidade superficial
div_mean_en: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the consultation is made.
div_mean_rev_en: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.
add_mean_en: Of good augury for military men.

keywords_upright: Harmonia familiar, plenitude afetiva, paz duradoura
keywords_reversed: Desarmonia no lar, desencontro familiar, ruptura temporária
div_mean_en: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
div_mean_rev_en: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.
add_mean_en: For a male Querent, a good marriage and one beyond his expectations.

keywords_upright: Mensagem afetuosa, jovem sonhador, sensibilidade
keywords_reversed: Imaturidade emocional, notícias decepcionantes, drama
div_mean_en: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.
div_mean_rev_en: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.
add_mean_en: Good augury; also a young man who is unfortunate in love.

keywords_upright: Proposta romântica, cavalheiro encantador, inspiração
keywords_reversed: Desilusão, promessas não cumpridas, temperamento volúvel
div_mean_en: Arrival, approach – sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.
div_mean_rev_en: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.
add_mean_en: A visit from a friend, who will bring unexpected money to the Querent.

keywords_upright: Amor incondicional, intuição aguçada, acolhimento materno
keywords_reversed: Insegurança emocional, ciúmes, excesso de apego
div_mean_en: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
div_mean_rev_en: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.
add_mean_en: Sometimes denotes a woman of equivocal character.
add_mean_rev_en: A rich marriage for a man and a distinguished one for a woman.

keywords_upright: Maturidade emocional, calma nas tempestades, compaixão
keywords_reversed: Instabilidade afetiva, repressão de sentimentos, manipulação
div_mean_en: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative intelligence.
div_mean_rev_en: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.
add_mean_en: Beware of ill-will on the part of a man of position, and of hypocrisy pretending to help.

keywords_upright: Novos começos, inocência, espontaneidade, espírito livre
keywords_reversed: Imprudência, risco desnecessário, ingenuidade, hesitação
div_mean_en: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.
div_mean_rev_en: Negligence, absence, distribution, carelessness, apathy, nullity, vanity.

keywords_upright: Manifestação, poder pessoal, ação, habilidade, foco
keywords_reversed: Ilusão, manipulação, potencial não utilizado, engano
div_mean_en: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.
div_mean_rev_en: Physician, Magus, mental disease, disgrace, disquiet.

keywords_upright: Intuição, mistério, sabedoria interior, inconsciente
keywords_reversed: Segredos revelados, desconexão interior, superficialidade
div_mean_en: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent, if male; the Querent herself, if female; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.
div_mean_rev_en: Passion, moral or physical ardour, conceit, surface knowledge.

keywords_upright: Fertilidade, abundância, criatividade, acolhimento, natureza
keywords_reversed: Bloqueio criativo, dependência, carência, descuido
div_mean_en: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.
div_mean_rev_en: Light, truth, the unravelling of involved matters, public rejoicings; according to another reading, vacillation.

keywords_upright: Estrutura, estabilidade, autoridade, liderança, ordem
keywords_reversed: Tirania, rigidez, controle excessivo, falta de disciplina
div_mean_en: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.
div_mean_rev_en: Benevolence, compassion, credit; also confusion to enemies, obstruction, immaturity.

keywords_upright: Tradição, sabedoria espiritual, ensinamentos, ética
keywords_reversed: Rebeldia, dogmatismo, hipocrisia, novos caminhos
div_mean_en: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.
div_mean_rev_en: Society, good understanding, concord, overkindness, weakness.

keywords_upright: Amor, união, escolhas do coração, harmonia, valores
keywords_reversed: Desarmonia, conflito de valores, má escolha, desconfiança
div_mean_en: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.
div_mean_rev_en: Failure, foolish designs. Another account speaks of marriage frustrated and contrarieties of all kinds.

keywords_upright: Determinação, superação, foco, vitória, autocontrole
keywords_reversed: Falta de rumo, perda de controle, agressividade, bloqueios
div_mean_en: Succour, providence; also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.
div_mean_rev_en: Riot, quarrel, dispute, litigation, defeat.

keywords_upright: Coragem, força interior, compaixão, paciência, domínio
keywords_reversed: Dúvida de si, fraqueza, raiva descontrolada, insegurança
div_mean_en: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.
div_mean_rev_en: Despotism, abuse of power, weakness, discord, sometimes even disgrace.

keywords_upright: Introspecção, busca interior, solidão fértil, orientação
keywords_reversed: Isolamento excessivo, solidão amarga, teimosia, fuga
div_mean_en: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.
div_mean_rev_en: Concealment, disguise, policy, fear, unreasoned caution.

keywords_upright: Ciclos do destino, reviravolta, sorte, mudanças positivas
keywords_reversed: Má sorte, resistência a mudanças, ciclos repetitivos
div_mean_en: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.
div_mean_rev_en: Increase, abundance, superfluity.

keywords_upright: Verdade, justiça, causa e efeito, clareza, integridade
keywords_reversed: Injustiça, desonestidade, parcialidade, falta de empatia
div_mean_en: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.
div_mean_rev_en: Law in all its departments, legal complications, bigotry, bias, excessive severity.

keywords_upright: Pausa, nova perspectiva, entrega, sacrifício voluntário
keywords_reversed: Estagnação, martírio inútil, teimosia, resistência
div_mean_en: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.
div_mean_rev_en: Selfishness, the crowd, body politic.

keywords_upright: Fim de ciclo, transformação, renovação profunda, desapego
keywords_reversed: Medo de mudança, apego ao passado, estagnação forçada
div_mean_en: End, mortality, destruction, corruption; also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor; for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.
div_mean_rev_en: Inertia, sleep, lethargy, petrifaction, somnambulism; hope destroyed.

keywords_upright: Equilíbrio, moderação, paciência, harmonia, cura
keywords_reversed: Desequilíbrio, excessos, impaciência, discórdia
div_mean_en: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.
div_mean_rev_en: Things connected with churches, religions, sects, the priesthood, sometimes even the priest who will marry the Querent; also disunion, unfortunate combinations, competing interests.

keywords_upright: Apegos, ilusões materiais, tentação, confronto com a sombra
keywords_reversed: Libertação, quebra de correntes, superação de vícios
div_mean_en: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.
div_mean_rev_en: Evil fatality, weakness, pettiness, blindness.

keywords_upright: Ruptura súbita, revelação, desmoronamento de ilusões
keywords_reversed: Desastre evitado, medo do colapso, atraso inevitável
div_mean_en: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.
div_mean_rev_en: According to one account, the same in a lesser degree; also oppression, imprisonment, tyranny.

keywords_upright: Esperança, fé, inspiração, renovação espiritual, brilho
keywords_reversed: Desesperança, desânimo, pessimismo, falta de fé
div_mean_en: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says – hope and bright prospects.
div_mean_rev_en: Arrogance, haughtiness, impotence.

keywords_upright: Ilusão, medo, sonhos, intuição, incerteza, o oculto
keywords_reversed: Clareza emergindo, superação de temores, engano revelado
div_mean_en: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.
div_mean_rev_en: Instability, inconstancy, silence, lesser degrees of deception and error.

keywords_upright: Alegria, sucesso, vitalidade, verdade, celebração
keywords_reversed: Otimismo exagerado, atraso passageiro, desmotivação
div_mean_en: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.
div_mean_rev_en: The same in a lesser sense.

keywords_upright: Despertar, chamado, renascimento, redenção, clareza
keywords_reversed: Auto-julgamento severo, hesitação em despertar, culpa
div_mean_en: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit.
div_mean_rev_en: Weakness, pusillanimity, simplicity; also deliberation, decision, sentence.

keywords_upright: Conclusão, plenitude, realização total, sucesso, viagem
keywords_reversed: Falta de encerramento, metas incompletas, estagnação
div_mean_en: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.
div_mean_rev_en: Inertia, fixity, stagnation, permanence.
